verdict.rationale: Evidence shows skills can be committed to a repo (`.agents/skills` scanned from cwd up to repo root, teams can check in module-specific skills) and installed to a local Codex setup via `$skill-installer`, implying both project-local and user-global-like scopes exist, but there's no explicit documentation contrasting a 'project-local vs user-global' install flag or config for plugins/skills. missing for 10: explicit docs on a user-global (all-projects) install location/flag distinct from project-local, and confirmation that plugin (not just skill) installs support both scopes.
